infobox.leads to: Jack of All Trades, Professional - Part 1

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Doping - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Alright, we're almost done with the stimulants. Just a few left, but I've got work up to my ears. So just grab them and try them out yourself in the Arena. What did you expect? I've already spent plenty of time fussing over you!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Zagustin stimulant
- Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Propital stimulant
- Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Meldonin stimulant

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +9,999 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 110,000 Roubles
- 30 GP coins
- Unlocks eTG-change regenerative stimulant injector in the Armory

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Requirement | Notes |
| Zagustin hemostatic drug injector | Required | Has to be active while making the kills |
| Propital regenerative stimulant injector | Required | Has to be active while making the kills |
| Meldonin injector | Required | Has to be active while making the kills |
